issues.summary: Rows above the Safenet step compute isLast from !showExecutionRow only, so when the Safenet row renders on a tx awaiting confirmations the connector is dropped
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: apps/web/src/components/transactions/TxSigners/index.tsx:270 and :280 set isLast={... && !showExecutionRow}, and the Safenet row at :287-293 also gets isLast={!showExecutionRow}, so both are 'last' and the line between them disappears. The PR description says TxSigners subscribes to the check so sibling isLast accounts for it, but the diff doesn't do that.

issues.summary: No TxSigners test for the Safenet row on a tx still awaiting signatures, or for isLast on the preceding row
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: The new TxSigners tests (index.test.tsx 'Safenet audit step') only build a SUCCESS tx with an execution row, so the isLast bug above goes uncaught.

issues.summary: The isSafenetEnabled guard in TxSigners duplicates the feature handle's own gating (the stub renders null when disabled)
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useLoadFeature (apps/web/src/features/__core__/useLoadFeature.ts) returns a proxy whose PascalCase stubs render null unless enabled and loaded, so the extra check at TxSigners/index.tsx:287 is mostly redundant. It costs nothing and slightly hardens the case where the flag flips off after the feature has loaded.

issues.summary: Claim that useLoadFeature triggers the dynamic import even when disabled
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: useLoadFeature.ts effect returns early with `if (isEnabled !== true) return` before calling handle.load(), so a chain with the flag off does no import.

issues.summary: No Storybook story for the new SafenetAuditRow component
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: No *.stories.tsx exists under apps/web/src/features/safenet-checks, while apps/web/AGENTS.md:148 and :380 require stories for new components with logic. The five status variants are covered only by unit tests.

issues.summary: The dark-mode icon color branch in SafenetAuditRow is untested
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: SafenetAuditRow.tsx:92 picks DARK_STEP_COLOR when useDarkMode() is true. No test mocks dark mode or asserts on iconColor, so removing the branch would not fail any test.

issues.summary: The new AuditRow props (actor, iconColor) and the changed showDash logic have no direct tests
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: apps/web/src/components/common/AuditLog has no test file. actor is exercised only through the Safenet tests, and iconColor and the `!actor` term in showDash (index.tsx:106) are not asserted anywhere.

issues.label: low
issues.evidence: packages/utils/src/features/safenet-checks/constants.ts:54 reads it, but apps/web/.env.example lists every other Safenet variable and not this one.

issues.summary: NEXT_PUBLIC_SAFENET_CHECKS_FORCE duplicates the existing local feature-flag override UI
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: apps/web/src/features/safenet-checks/index.ts:12 adds an env force path, while the sidebar's Feature flags developer panel already exists (the PR's own test steps use it). That leaves two override mechanisms for one flag.

issues.summary: The attestation-event selection (oracle first, plain as fallback) is duplicated between the component and the API
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: SafenetAuditRow.tsx:78-80 re-implements the find chain from packages/store/src/safenet/safenetCheckApi.ts:49-51. Nothing shares or enforces it, so the link could drift from the event that was actually verified.

issues.summary: The 'one RPC per settled check' comment understates how often the header read runs
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: safenetCheckApi.ts:53-59 calls blockTimeMs on every query run that sees an attested event: refetches after the cache expires, remounts, and polls where verification didn't settle. The comment only holds on the happy path.

issues.summary: A failing header read rotates through every RPC endpoint and delays the verdict, because it is awaited in Promise.all with verification
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: safenetReader.ts blockTimeMs wraps withProvider, which retries endpoints on throw, and safenetCheckApi.ts:56 awaits it together with verifyAttestation. A slow or failing header read therefore holds back a verdict that doesn't need the date. Minor latency only.

issues.summary: The feature contract lives in types.ts instead of the documented contract.ts
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: Every other lazy feature has contract.ts (apps/web/docs/feature-architecture.md), but safenet-checks puts SafenetChecksContract in types.ts. It is a consistency deviation; the only public exposure is a type-only re-export, as other features do.

issues.summary: feature.tsx should be feature.ts like every other feature
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: apps/web/src/features/safenet-checks/feature.tsx has no JSX, and all other features use feature.ts (ls apps/web/src/features/*/feature.ts*). The extension is cosmetic.

issues.summary: Comment density is heavier than the repo's comments-as-tech-debt guideline
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: TxSigners/index.tsx:285, SafenetAuditRow.tsx (e.g. :64, :99, :104) and safenetCheckApi.ts:53 add explanatory comments, some of which restate the code. This is style with no functional cost.

issues.summary: useChain(snapshot?.chainId ?? '') relies on the empty string resolving to undefined
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: SafenetAuditRow.tsx:65 has to call the hook unconditionally, and useChain('') returns undefined (useChains.ts:28-34), which is the fallback path. It works; any change would only be about readability.

issues.summary: Redundant optional chaining on snapshot after the early return
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: SafenetAuditRow.tsx:68 returns when !snapshot, so `snapshot?.events` at :79-80 could be `snapshot.events`. Purely stylistic.

issues.summary: The Safenet row's date can read later than Executed
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: This is intended: the JSDoc at SafenetAuditRow.tsx:49-55 and the PR description both say the row keeps its lifecycle position and reports the attested block time.

issues.summary: In light mode, Risk detected and failed statuses use the default icon color
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: This is intended: the PR description says 'Status colors apply in dark mode only; in light mode ... the severity signal is the label', and the comment at SafenetAuditRow.tsx:31 says the same.
